messages:
Maya: Arbiter asked for a targeted perf/W + throughput sweep next week. Focus: kernel variants, quant recipes, and steady-state thermal behavior. Theywant publishable numbers for marketplace tile if we hit the thresholds.

Ajay: I can run kernel tune matrix on their dev nodes. Need the exact model + workload mixes and a list of kernel patches to try. Batch/seq targets?

Maya: Primary model: rwd-llama-2-13b. Runs: (A) interactive gen: batch=1 seq=1024; (B) high-throughput: batch=16 seq=256. Baselines: fp16 on stock kernel; probes: tuned kernel + fp16, tuned kernel + int8. Goal: p99 < 200ms for batch=1 and perf/W >=10% vs baseline to consider co-announcement.

Linh: I'll wire telemetry and the S3 pipeline. Telemetry needed: batcher.stats, kvcache.hits, perf_events (cycles/instr), power.log@1s, hw_temp.log, and pprofs for kernel hotspots. Also implement scrub for any payloads.

Diego: Arbiter legal wants a short addendum permitting aggregate perf/W publication and using partner logo on marketing collateral. I'll coordinate legal sign-off. They want runs Mon/Tue.

bench-bot: Run queue created: id=arbiter-1747659999-01. Please upload run manifests to s3://redwood-bench/arbiter/manifests/ as run-<ts>.json.

Ajay: Proposed command (will put script in repo):

```
./run_bench --model rwd-llama-2-13b \
  --device arbiter-x1 --batch 16 --seq 256 \
  --kernel tune-A --quant int8-probe \
  --power /sys/class/powercap/rapl \
  --out s3://redwood-bench/arbiter/1747659999/
```

Ajay: Run plan: cold start pass (3 iters) then steady-state (10 iters). Measure ambient/die temps, pin cpus and disable background services.

Linh: Scrub example in harness:
```
jq 'del(.inputs,.user_id,.session_meta)' run_output.json > run_output.scrub.json
```
I'll also add an uploader that posts manifest on completion.

Maya: Owners: Ajay (kernel runs), Linh (telemetry + uploads), Diego (NDA/legal), Eva (announcement playbook). Deliverable: first run Monday morning.

Eva: Marketing thresholds: >=20% perf/W => joint blog + marketplace tile; 10-20% => joint case study; <10% => internal findings + config recommendations. Need embargoed messaging prior to publish.

Diego: Legal update: Arbiter sent addendum. Summary: publish aggregated perf/W with partner mention allowed; raw logs with potential customer data must be excluded. Flagged retention terms on thermal logs.

Maya: Linh, ensure any sensitive traces are removed before upload. Only power, temp, pprof, batch stats, and aggregated metrics go to S3.

Linh: Will scrub and include kvcache and batcher CSVs only. Opening small PR for telemetry schema and scrub pipeline.

Ajay: Reminder: run float16 baseline on tuned kernel as well to separate quantization impact vs kernel changes. So AB matrix: stock+fp16, tuned+fp16, tuned+int8.

bench-bot: Metadata tag reminder: partner=arbiter, story=perf-w, env=dev. Expected ~4h per configuration.

Maya: Final checklist for Monday:
- Ajay: scripts + kernel patches in branch arbiter-bench
- Linh: harness + scrub + uploader ready
- Diego: signed addendum or exception from legal
- Eva: embargoed announcement draft and tile template

Ajay: I'll push run scripts to repo by EOD and post link.

Linh: PR for telemetry schema incoming now.

Diego: I'll confirm logo permissions and prepare an exec one-pager embargoed if numbers look good.

Maya: Thanks team. Reconvene in-thread after steady-state pass with a short summary and the initial perf/W deltas. :thumbsup:
